statement: India's fast-paced growth has sharply increased water demand, especially in agriculture, industry, and homes. With surface water dwindling, reliance on groundwater is rising, leading to depletion from overuse and climate change. Sustainable management is urgently needed to ensure future water security.
The Company’s policy required to conduct operations in such a manner, so as to ensure safety of all concerned, compliances environmental regulations and preservation of natural resources.
